## The "Bone-Setter" for Human-Centric Infrastructure

I bridge the critical gap between public policy, C-suite strategy, and front-line data integrity. Specializing in systems and workflow translation, I architect human-centric infrastructure that resolves operational friction and scales technical programs without losing sight of the people they serve.

### Strategic Leadership

* **Honest Advisor:** Spearheaded front-line data protection during an 18,000-patient Epic migration at Callen-Lorde. Reported directly to executive leadership to unblock operational friction points and translate clinical realities into strategic architecture.
* **Supervisory Command:** Directed end-to-end program delivery at Del Monsoon, rapidly assessing and deploying resources to scale from a lean core team to large-scale, cross-functional execution units. Managed both direct contingent personnel and tangential vendor networks to ensure flawless operational continuity.

### Active Architecture & Development

* **Transit-Accessible Provider Routing (In Development):** Architecting a dbt and BigQuery ELT pipeline to integrate NYS Medicaid/Medicare Enrolled Provider data with MTA Static GTFS transit data. The objective is to bridge the "referral gap" by mapping healthcare access against public transit infrastructure. The schema utilizes Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 2) to track provider mobility, enabling patients to filter accessible care by specific subway/bus lines and ADA-compliant stops.

* **Patient Experience Survey Clustering (In Discussion):** Partnering with the Patient Experience manager at Callen-Lorde to shape a KMeans-based clustering workflow for open-ended survey comments. The project is being designed to turn unstructured patient feedback into interpretable service themes, with data mining methods planned for later expansion.

### Comprehensive Architecture & Operational History

My foundational modeling work spans 3rd Normal Form clinical database design, civic ELT pipelines (Kimball Star Schema), and predictive geospatial analytics.
